reasoning_content:
Wave 2 is in progress. While the build is running, let me check the progress periodically. These builds each take a few minutes (uv sync + compilation). 26 services at PAR=2 will take a while. Let me wait and check periodically.

In the meantime, let me think about what else needs to be done:
1. Frontend monorepo image — build completed (rc? needs checking).
2. Sub-MFE images (mfe-ewm, mfe-fp, mfe-ws, shell) — the orchestrator's wave B ran these… no wait, I killed the orchestrator during wave B, before the sub-MFEs. The frontend build was still running as an orphan. Let me check whether the frontend image exists, and whether the sub-MFE builds were started (they come after the frontend build in the script).

Let me check the state.
